1. (Currently amended) A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more __polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid__.

2. (Currently amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two __different__ OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

3. (Currently amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one __polyisocyanate modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid, wherein the polyisocyanate is derived from__ an aliphatic diisocyanate.

4. (Previously presented) The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

5. (Previously presented) A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

6. (Previously presented) A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.
